Coram : V.N. KHARE, S.B. SINHA
OF ORISSA AND ORS. v. JOGINDER PATJOSHI AND ANR. NOVEMBER 13, 2003 [V.N. KHARE, CJ. AND S.B. SINHA, J.] Service Law: Orissa Revised Scales of Pay Rules, 1985: rr. 8(/)(a) and (b)-Revision of pay scales and fixation of pay­ Lecturers and Professors-Prior to revision of pay w.ef 1.1.1986, Court allowing writ petition holding that though petitioners' case fell under r. 8(/)(a), they were entitled to one further increment as per exception contained in r.8(/)(b), and the rule being a beneficial one required liberal construction-Held, there being no ambiguity in r. 8(/)(a),
Decision Date : 13-11-2003 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5579/1998 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
